title: SSM Access via CreateTags Lateral Movement
description: SSM Session Manager access can be restricted via resource tags (e.g., only principals with a specific tag can start sessions on instances with a matching tag). An attacker with ec2:CreateTags or ssm:AddTagsToResource can add the required tags to target instances, satisfying the session policy. The attacker then uses ssm:StartSession to gain interactive shell access to the instances without SSH keys or open port 22. This bypasses tag-based access controls for lateral movement.

steps.context: Add tags to instance to satisfy SSM session policy
Start SSM session for interactive access
